\"clab-\"+c.Config.Name),\n306: \t\t\t\t\t\t)\n307: \t\t\t\t\t} else {\n308: \t\t\t\t\t\tif wd, err := os.Getwd(); err == nil && wd != \"\" {\n309: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tcandidates = append(\n310: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcandidates,\n311: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tfilepath.Join(wd, \"clab-\"+c.Config.Name),\n312: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t)\n313: \t\t\t\t\t\t}\n314: \t\t\t\t\t}\n315: \t\t\t\t\tfor _, cand := range candidates {\n316: \t\t\t\t\t\tif _, err := os.Stat(cand); err == nil {\n317: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tlabDir = cand\n318: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tbreak\n319: \t\t\t\t\t\t}\n320: \t\t\t\t\t}\n321: \t\t\t\t\tif labDir == \"\" {\n322: \t\t\t\t\t\tlog.Info(\n323: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"lab directory not found, nothing to clean\",\n324: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"candidates\",\n325: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tcandidates,\n326: \t\t\t\t\t\t)\n327: \t\t\t\t\t\treturn nil\n328: \t\t\t\t\t}\n329: \t\t\t\t} else {\n330: \t\t\t\t\tlog.Info(\"lab directory not found, nothing to clean\")\n331: \t\t\t\t\treturn nil\n332: \t\t\t\t}\n333: \t\t\t}\n334: = c.ListNodesContainersIgnoreNotFound(ctx)\n399: \t} else if c.Config.Name != \"\" {\n400: \t\tcontainers, err = c.ListContainers(ctx, WithListLabName(c.Config.Name))\n401: \t}\n402: \n403: \tif err \t\t\tif _, desired := c.Nodes[ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName]]; desired {\n418: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n419: \t\t\t}\n420: \t\t\tcontainers = append(containers, ctr)\n421: \t\t\tif nil {\n481: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"error while deleting netns symlinks: %w\", err)\n482: \t\t}\n483: \t}\n484: \n485: \t// Sweep this lab's leftover parking netns entries. Destroyed labs have\n486: \t// nothing left to migrate or restore, so entries abandoned by an\n487: \t// interrupted bridge-port migration are removed, parked ports included.\n488: \t// Candidates are the deploy nodes plus every node recorded in the lab\n489: \t// state, so slots of bridges that left the topology still get swept.\n490: \tlongNames := make([]string, 0, len(c.Nodes))\n491: \tfor _, node := range c.Nodes {\n492: \t\tif cfg := node.Config(); cfg != nil {\n493: \t\t\tlongNames = append(longNames, cfg.LongName)\n494: \t\t}\n495: \t}\n496: \n497: \tstate, err := c.LoadState()\n498: \tswitch {\n499: \tcase err != nil:\n500: \t\t// Mirror the management-network cleanup wording; a missing state only\n501: \t\t// narrows the sweep to the current topology's nodes.\n502: \t\tlog.Debug(\"Unable to load the parking netns entries recorded in the lab state\", \"error\", err)\n503: \tcase state != nil && state.Topology != nil:\n504: \t\t// Slots of nodes that left the topology since the last deploy still\n505: \t\t// get swept through the recorded state.\n506: \t\tfor nodeName := range state.Topology.Nodes {\n507: \t\t\tlongNames = append(longNames, fmt.Sprintf(\"clab-%s-%s\", c.Config.Name, nodeName))\n508: \t\t}\n509: \t}\n510: \n511: \tif err := clabutils.SweepParkingNetnses(longNames...); err != nil {\n512: \t\tlog.Warnf(\"failed to clean up parking namespaces: %v\", err)\n513: \t}\n514: \n515: \t// delete every defined management network, including extra networks\n516: \t// that apply may have left without nodes, and networks a previous\n517: \t// deployment recorded in the lab state but the topology no longer defines\n518: \tfor _, m := range c.mgmtNetworksForCleanup() {\n519: \t\tif m.Network == \"bridge\" || keepMgmtNet {\n520: \t\t\tcontinue\n521: \t\t}\n522: \t\tlog.Debugf(\"Calling DeleteNet method. Management network value is: %+v\", m)\n523: \n524: \t\trt, rtErr := c.mgmtRuntime(c.globalRuntimeName, m)\n525: \t\tif rtErr != nil {\n526: \t\t\t// runtimes without multiple network support never created extra networks\n527: \t\t\tlog.Debug(\"Skipping management network deletion\", \"network\", m.Network, \"error\", rtErr)\n528: \t\t\tcontinue\n529: \t\t}\n530: \t\tif err = rt.DeleteNet(ctx); err != nil {\n531: \t\t\tswitch {\n532: \t\t\tcase err.Error() == fmt.Sprintf(\"Error: No such network: %s\", m.Network):\n533: \t\t\tcase strings.Contains(err.Error(), fmt.Sprintf(\" network %s not found\", m.Network)):\n534: \t\t\tdefault:\n535: \t\t\t\tlog.Error(err)\n536: \t\t\t}\n537: \t\t}\n538: \t}\n539: \n540: \treturn nil\n541: }\n542: \n543: func (c *CLab) addMgmtNetworksFromContainers(containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer) {\n544: \tfor _, ctr := range containers {\n545: \t\tswitch name := ctr.NetworkName; name {\n546: \t\tcase \"\", \"unknown\", \"bridge\", \"host\", \"none\":\n547: \t\tdefault:\n548: \t\t\tif c.mgmtNetByNetwork(name).Network == name {\n549: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n550: \t\t\t}\n551: \t\t\tc.Config.MgmtNetworks = append(c.Config.MgmtNetworks, &clabtypes.MgmtNet{\n552: \t\t\t\tNetwork:        name,\n553: \t\t\t\tBridge:         ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeMgmtNetBr],\n554: \t\t\t\tExternalAccess: new(true),\n555: \t\t\t})\n556: \t\t}\n557: \t}\n558: }\n559: \n560: // mgmtNetworksForCleanup returns the management networks to delete on destroy:\n561: // the topology-defined ones plus any network a previous deployment recorded in\n562: // the lab state but that the current topology no longer defines. Without the\n563: // state record a network dropped from the mgmt list would never be removed.\n564: func (c *CLab) mgmtNetworksForCleanup() clabtypes.MgmtNetworks {\n565: \tnetworks := \t}\n604: \tsort.Strings(nodeNames)\n605: \n606: \thookNodes := make([]clabnodes.Node, 0, len(nodeNames))\n607: \tvar tailscaleContainers []clabruntime.GenericContainer\n608: \tfor _, nodeName := \t\t\truntimeNode.containers[0].Labels[clabconstants.NodeKind] == clabnodestailscale.KindName {\n618: \t\t\ttailscaleContainers = append(tailscaleContainers, runtimeNode.containers...)\n619: := range tailscaleContainers {\n627: \t\tlogoutWg.Go(func() { c.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, ctr) })\n628: \t}\n629: \tc.preDestroyNodes(ctx, hookNodes, 0)\n630: \tlogoutWg.Wait()\n631: \n632: \tfor _, nodeName := range nodeNames {\n633: \t\truntimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]\n634: \t\tif runtimeNode.external || runtimeNode.rootNamespaceBased {\n635: \t\t\tcontinue\n636: \t\t}\n637: \n638: \t\tfor i := len(runtimeNode.containers) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {\n639: \t\t\tctr := runtimeNode.containers[i]\n640: \t\t\tif len(ctr.Names) == 0 {\n641: \t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"runtime container for node %q has no name\", nodeName)\n642: \t\t\t}\n643: \n644: \t\t\truntime := ctr.Runtime\n645: \t\t\tif runtime == nil {\n646: \t\t\t\truntime = c.globalRuntime()\n647: \t\t\t}\n648: \n649: \t\t\taction := \"Deleting node\"\n650: \t\t\tif _, recreate := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreate {\n651: \t\t\t\taction = \"Deleting node for recreate\"\n652: \t\t\t}\n653: os.IsNotExist(err) {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Info(\"lab directory not found, nothing to clean\", \"path\", labDir)\n\t\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t\t} else if err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Debug(\"failed to stat lab directory, skipping\", \"path\", labDir, \"error\", err)\n\t\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tlog.Info(\"Removing lab directory\", \"path\", labDir)\n\t\t\tif err := os.RemoveAll(labDir); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"error deleting lab directory: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, labdir := range topos {\n\t\tif failedLabDirs[labdir] {\n\t\t\tlog.Warnf(\n\t\t\t\t\"keeping lab directory %s: the lab was not destroyed, so its state is kept for a later attempt\",\n\t\t\t\tlabdir,\n\t\t\t)\n\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\terr := os.RemoveAll(labdir)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"error deleting lab directory: %v\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) destroy(ctx context.Context, maxWorkers uint, keepMgmtNet bool) error {\n\tvar containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer\n\tvar orphanSidecars []clabruntime.GenericContainer\n\tvar err error\n\n\t// If we have nodes defined (from topology file), list containers by node.\n\t// Otherwise, list containers by lab name label (for destroy-by-name-only case).\n\tif len(c.Nodes) > 0 {\n\t\tcontainers, err = c.ListNodesContainersIgnoreNotFound(ctx)\n\t} else if c.Config.Name != \"\" {\n\t\tcontainers, err = c.ListContainers(ctx, WithListLabName(c.Config.Name))\n\t}\n\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif len(c.Nodes) == 0 {\n\t\tc.addMgmtNetworksFromContainers(containers)\n\t}\n\n\tif len(c.Nodes) > 0 {\n\t\ttailscaleContainers, err := c.discoverTailscaleContainers(ctx, c.nodeFilter)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, ctr := range tailscaleContainers {\n\t\t\tif _, desired := c.Nodes[ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName]]; desired {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcontainers = append(containers, ctr)\n\t\t\tif ctr.Labels[clabconstants.ToolType] == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\torphanSidecars = append(orphanSidecars, ctr)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif len(containers) == 0 {\n\t\tif len(c.Nodes) > 0 && len(c.Links) > 0 {\n\t\t\tc.deleteSpecialLinkNodes(ctx)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tif maxWorkers == 0 {\n\t\tmaxWorkers = uint(len(containers))\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Info(\"Destroying lab\", \"name\", c.Config.Name)\n\n\t// If we have nodes defined, use the normal node-based deletion.\n\t// Otherwise, delete containers directly via the runtime (for destroy-by-name-only case).\n\tif len(c.Nodes) > 0 {\n\t\tc.preDestroyNodes(ctx, slices.Collect(maps.Values(c.Nodes)), maxWorkers)\n\n\t\terr := clablinks.CleanupFilteredLinks(\n\t\t\tctx,\n\t\t\tc.Config.Topology.Links,\n\t\t\tc.Config.Name,\n\t\t\tc.nodeFilter,\n\t\t)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.deleteNodes(ctx, maxWorkers)\n\t\tc.deleteLeftoverLabContainers(ctx)\n\t\tc.deleteContainersDirect(ctx, orphanSidecars)\n\t} else {\n\t\tc.deleteContainersDirect(ctx, containers)\n\t}\n\n\tc.deleteToolContainers(ctx)\n\n\tlog.Info(\"Removing host entries\", \"path\", \"/etc/hosts\")\n\n\terr = c.DeleteEntriesFromHostsFile()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"error while trying to clean up the hosts file: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Info(\"Removing SSH config\", \"path\", c.TopoPaths.SSHConfigPath())\n\n\terr = c.RemoveSSHConfig(c.TopoPaths)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Errorf(\"failed to remove ssh config file: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// delete container network namespaces symlinks\n\tfor _, node := range c.Nodes {\n\t\terr = node.DeleteNetnsSymlink()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"error while deleting netns symlinks: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Sweep this lab's leftover parking netns entries. Destroyed labs have\n\t// nothing left to migrate or restore, so entries abandoned by an\n\t// interrupted bridge-port migration are removed, parked ports included.\n\t// Candidates are the deploy nodes plus every node recorded in the lab\n\t// state, so slots of bridges that left the topology still get swept.\n\tlongNames := make([]string, 0, len(c.Nodes))\n\tfor _, node := range c.Nodes {\n\t\tif cfg := node.Config(); cfg != nil {\n\t\t\tlongNames = append(longNames, cfg.LongName)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tstate, err := c.LoadState()\n\tswitch {\n\tcase err != nil:\n\t\t// Mirror the management-network cleanup wording; a missing state only\n\t\t// narrows the sweep to the current topology's nodes.\n\t\tlog.Debug(\"Unable to load the parking netns entries recorded in the lab state\", \"error\", err)\n\tcase state != nil && state.Topology != nil:\n\t\t// Slots of nodes that left the topology since the last deploy still\n\t\t// get swept through the recorded state.\n\t\tfor nodeName := range state.Topology.Nodes {\n\t\t\tlongNames = append(longNames, fmt.Sprintf(\"clab-%s-%s\", c.Config.Name, nodeName))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif err := clabutils.SweepParkingNetnses(longNames...); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Warnf(\"failed to clean up parking namespaces: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// delete every defined management network, including extra networks\n\t// that apply may have left without nodes, and networks a previous\n\t// deployment recorded in the lab state but the topology no longer defines\n\tfor _, m := range c.mgmtNetworksForCleanup() {\n\t\tif m.Network == \"bridge\" || keepMgmtNet {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tlog.Debugf(\"Calling DeleteNet method. Management network value is: %+v\", m)\n\n\t\trt, rtErr := c.mgmtRuntime(c.globalRuntimeName, m)\n\t\tif rtErr != nil {\n\t\t\t// runtimes without multiple network support never created extra networks\n\t\t\tlog.Debug(\"Skipping management network deletion\", \"network\", m.Network, \"error\", rtErr)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err = rt.DeleteNet(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\tswitch {\n\t\t\tcase err.Error() == fmt.Sprintf(\"Error: No such network: %s\", m.Network):\n\t\t\tcase strings.Contains(err.Error(), fmt.Sprintf(\" network %s not found\", m.Network)):\n\t\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\t\tlog.Error(err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) addMgmtNetworksFromContainers(containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer) {\n\tfor _, ctr := range containers {\n\t\tswitch name := ctr.NetworkName; name {\n\t\tcase \"\", \"unknown\", \"bridge\", \"host\", \"none\":\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tif c.mgmtNetByNetwork(name).Network == name {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tc.Config.MgmtNetworks = append(c.Config.MgmtNetworks, &clabtypes.MgmtNet{\n\t\t\t\tNetwork:        name,\n\t\t\t\tBridge:         ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeMgmtNetBr],\n\t\t\t\tExternalAccess: new(true),\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// mgmtNetworksForCleanup returns the management networks to delete on destroy:\n// the topology-defined ones plus any network a previous deployment recorded in\n// the lab state but that the current topology no longer defines. networks\n\t}\n\tif state == nil {\n\t\treturn networks\n\t}\n\n\tdefined := make(map[string]bool, len(networks))\n\tfor _, m := range networks {\n\t\tdefined[m.Network] = true\n\t}\n\tfor _, name := networks\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) deleteApplyNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {\n\tnodeNames := make([]string, 0, len(plan.deletedNodeSet)+len(plan.recreatedNodeSet))\n\tfor nodeName := {\n\t\truntimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]\n\t\tif runtimeNode == nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"runtime node %q not found\", nodeName)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif runtimeNode.external || A workers value of 0 runs all hooks at once.\nfunc (*CLab) preDestroyNodes(ctx context.Context, nodes []clabnodes.Node, workers uint) {\n\tif workers == 0 || workers > uint(len(nodes)) {\n\t\tworkers = uint(len(nodes))\n\t}\n\n\tsem := make(chan struct{}, workers)\n\twg := new(sync.WaitGroup)\n\n\tfor _, n := range nodes {\n\t\twg.Add(1)\n\t\tsem <- struct{}{}\n\n\t\tgo func() {\n\t\t\tdefer wg.Done()\n\t\t\tdefer func() { <-sem }()\n\n\t\t\tif n.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif err := n.PreDestroy(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Warnf(\"node %q pre-destroy hook failed: %v\", n.Config().ShortName, err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}()\n\t}\n\n\twg.Wait()\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) deleteNodes(ctx context.Context, workers uint) {\n\twg := new(sync.WaitGroup)\n\n\tconcurrentChan := make(chan clabnodes.Node)\n\n\tworkerFunc := func(i uint, input chan clabnodes.Node, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {\n\t\tdefer wg.Done()\n\n\t\tfor {\n\t\t\tselect {\n\t\t\tcase n := <-input:\n\t\t\t\tif n == nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"Worker %d terminating...\", i)\n\t\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\terr := n.Delete(ctx)\n\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"could not remove container %q: %v\", n.Config().LongName, err)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// start concurrent workers\n\twg.Add(int(workers))\n\n\tfor i := range workers {\n\t\tgo workerFunc(i, concurrentChan, wg)\n\t}\n\n\t// send nodes to workers\n\tfor _, n := range c.Nodes {\n\t\tconcurrentChan <- n\n\t}\n\n\t// close channel to terminate the workers\n\tclose(concurrentChan)\n\n\twg.Wait()\n\n\t// Host and mgmt-br links must be removed only after node workers finish.\n\t// vxlan-stitch teardown deletes veth pairs from containers concurrently with\n\t// host-namespace VXLAN interfaces; non-selected containers must be preserved\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tcontainers, err := c.ListContainers(ctx, WithListLabName(c.Config.Name))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Warnf(\"Failed to list containers for the lab leftover sweep: %v\", err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\townedByTopology := make(map[string]struct{}, len(c.Nodes))\n\tfor _, node := range c.Nodes {\n\t\tif cfg := node.Config(); cfg != nil {\n\t\t\townedByTopology[cfg.LongName] = struct{}{}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\trt := c.globalRuntime()\n\n\tfor _, cont := range containers {\n\t\tif len(cont.Names) == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, owned := ownedByTopology[cont.Names[0]]; owned {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif cont.Labels[clabconstants.ToolType] != \"\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlog.Warnf(\"Removing leftover container %q; its node is not part of the rendered topology\",\n\t\t\tcont.Names[0])\n\n\t\tif err := rt.DeleteContainer(ctx, cont.Names[0]); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Error(\"Failed to remove tool container\", \"tool\", toolType,\n\t\t\t\t\t\"container\", containerName, \"error\", err)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Info(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"Tool container removed successfully\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\"tool\",\n\t\t\t\t\ttoolType,\n\t\t\t\t\t\"container\",\n\t\t\t\t\tcontainerName,\n\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc cliPromptToDestroyAll(topos map[string]string) error {\n\tvar sb strings.Builder\n\n\tidx := 1\n\n\tfor topo, labDir := range topos {\n\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"  %d. 148: 			})

152: 			// retrieve link ref

154: 			if err != nil {
155: 				return err
156: 			}
157: 			// bring the link up
158: 			err = netlink.LinkSetUp(netlinkLink)
159: 			if err != nil {
160: 				return err
161: 			}
162: 			return nil
163: 		})
164: 		if err != nil {
165: 			return err
166: 		}
167: 	}
168: 	n.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)

172: // waitForParentContainer waits for the parent container to have a joinable network namespace.
173: // This is necessary for BridgeNS bridges which execute operations in the parent container's
174: // namespace.
175: func (n *bridge) waitForParentContainer(ctx context.Context, parentNode clabnodes.Node) error {
176: 	// Poll until parent container has a joinable network namespace or context is cancelled
177: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
178: 	defer ticker.Stop()
179: 
180: 	for {
181: 		select {
182: 		case <-ctx.Done():
183: 			return ctx.Err()
184: 		case <-ticker.C:
185: 			status := parentNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)
186: 			if clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(status) {
187: 				return nil
188: 			}
189: 			if status == clabruntime.NotFound {
190: 				// Parent container doesn't exist yet, keep waiting
191: 				continue
192: 			}
193: 			if status == clabruntime.Stopped {
194: 				return fmt.Errorf(
195: 					"parent container %q has stopped (status=%s)",
196: 					n.containerNs,
197: 					status,
198: 				)
199: 			}
200: 		}
201: 	}
202: }

204: // ExecFunction executes the given function in the bridge's network namespace.
205: // For BridgeNS bridges (in-container bridges), this executes in the parent container's namespace.
206: // For host bridges, this executes in the host's root namespace.
207: func (b *bridge) ExecFunction(ctx context.Context, f func(ns.NetNS) error) error {
208: 	// For BridgeNS bridges, we need to execute in the parent container's namespace
209: 	if b.containerNs != "" {
210: 		parentNode, err := b.resolveParentNode()
211: 		if err != nil {
212: 			// Without the wired parent there is no namespace to execute in.
213: 			return err
214: 		}
215: 		return parentNode.ExecFunction(ctx, f)
216: 	}
217: 	// For host bridges, execute in the current (host) namespace
218: 	curNs, err := ns.GetCurrentNS()
219: 	if err != nil {
220: 		return err
221: 	}
222: 	return curNs.Do(f)
223: }

272: // enslaveBridgePortsInNamespace re-enslaves this bridge's tracked endpoint
273: // interfaces (bridge-side veth ends) to the bridge inside the parent's
274: // namespace. Moving interfaces between namespaces (e.g. parking during parent
275: // recreation) clears the master, so restore paths need this fixup. Ports
276: // already enslaved are left untouched; missing ports are skipped and remain
277: // the link deployment path's responsibility.
278: func (b *bridge) enslaveBridgePortsInNamespace() error {
279: 	bridgeName := b.nameWithoutSeparatorSuffix()
280: 	nodeName := b.GetShortName()
281: 
282: 	return b.ExecFunction(context.Background(), func(_ ns.NetNS) error {
283: 		bridgeLink, err := netlink.LinkByName(bridgeName)
284: 		if err != nil {
285: 			log.Debugf(
286: 				"bridge %q not found while enslaving ports, skipping: %v",
287: 				bridgeName,
288: 				err,
289: 			)
290: 			return nil
291: 		}
292: 
293: 		links, err := netlink.LinkList()
294: 		if err != nil {
295: 			return err
296: 		}
297: 
298: 		for _, ep := range b.GetEndpoints() {
299: 			for _, link := range links {
300: 				if !clablinks.HasOwnershipAltNameFor(
301: 					link,
302: 					nodeName,
303: 					ep.GetIfaceName(),
304: 				) {
305: 					continue
306: 				}
307: 
308: 				if link.Attrs().MasterIndex != bridgeLink.Attrs().Index {
309: 					if err := netlink.LinkSetMaster(link, bridgeLink); err != nil {
310: 						return fmt.Errorf("failed to enslave %q to %q: %w",
311: 							link.Attrs().Name, bridgeName, err)
312: 					}
313: 					log.Info(
314: 						"Re-enslaved restored bridge port to bridge",
315: 						"node",
316: 						nodeName,
317: 						"port",
318: 						link.Attrs().Name,
319: 					)
320: 				}
321: 
322: 				if link.Attrs().OperState != netlink.OperUp {
323: 					if err := netlink.LinkSetUp(link); err != nil {
324: 						return fmt.Errorf("failed to bring up %q: %w",
325: 							link.Attrs().Name, err)
326: 					}
327: 				}
328: 			}
329: 		}
330: 
331: 		return nil
332: 	})
333: }

377: // validateContainerModeName enforces the "<bridge>|<container>" naming
378: // convention of a container-based bridge node before any name-based slicing
379: // or parsing is done on it. The bridge device part must be non-empty and the
380: // suffix must match the network-mode target exactly, which rejects names
381: // carrying a second separator as well.
382: func (b *bridge) validateContainerModeName() error {
383: 	target, err := clabutils.ContainerNameFromNetworkMode(b.Cfg.NetworkMode)
384: 	if err != nil {
385: 		return err
386: 	}
387: 	if target == "" {
388: 		return fmt.Errorf("container based bridge %q: network-mode %q names no container",
389: 			b.GetShortName(), b.Cfg.NetworkMode)
390: 	}
391: 	device, nameSuffix, found := strings.Cut(b.GetShortName(), bridgeNodeSep)
392: 	if !found || device == "" {
393: 		return fmt.Errorf(
394: 			"container based bridge %q requires the name pattern '<bridge>|<container>', e.g. 'br01|%s'",
395: 			b.GetShortName(),
396: 			target,
397: 		)
398: 	}
399: 	if nameSuffix != target {
400: 		return fmt.Errorf("container based bridge requires container name as suffix %s != %s",
401: 			target, nameSuffix)
402: 	}
403: 	return nil
404: }

505: func (b *bridge) installIPTablesBridgeFwdRule() (err error) {
506: 	f, err := firewall.NewFirewallClient()

508: 		return err
509: 	}

512: 	r := definitions.FirewallRule{
513: 		Interface: b.nameWithoutSeparatorSuffix(),
514: 		Direction: definitions.InDirection,
515: 		Action:    definitions.AcceptAction,
516: 		Comment:   definitions.ContainerlabComment,
517: 		Table:     definitions.FilterTable,
518: 		Chain:     definitions.ForwardChain,
519: 	}
520: 	err = f.InstallForwardingRules(&r)
521: 	if err != nil {
522: 		return err
523: 	}
524: 
525: 	r = definitions.FirewallRule{
526: 		Interface: b.nameWithoutSeparatorSuffix(),
527: 		Direction: definitions.OutDirection,
528: 		Action:    definitions.AcceptAction,
529: 		Comment:   definitions.ContainerlabComment,
530: 		Table:     definitions.FilterTable,
531: 		Chain:     definitions.ForwardChain,
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	return f.InstallForwardingRules(&r)
535: }

53: 
54: 		if c.Config.Name != "" {
55: 			listOpts = []ListOption{WithListLabName(c.Config.Name)}
56: 		} else {
57: 			listOpts = []ListOption{WithListclabLabelExists()}
58: 		}
59: 
60: 		containers, err = c.ListContainers(ctx, listOpts...)
61: 	}
62: 
63: 	if err != nil {
64: 		return err
65: 	}
66: 
67: 	// topo will hold the reference to the topology file
68: 	// as the key and the respective lab directory as the referenced value
69: 	topos := map[string]string{}
70: 
71: 	for idx := range containers {
72: 		topoFile, ok := containers[idx].Labels[clabconstants.TopoFile]
73: 		if !ok {
74: 			continue
75: 		}
76: 
77: 		topos[topoFile] = filepath.Dir(containers[idx].Labels[clabconstants.NodeLabDir])
78: 	}
79: 
80: 	// failedLabDirs records the lab directories whose destroy failed or was never
81: 	// attempted. --cleanup keeps those directories: deleting the lab directory of
82: 	// a lab that is still running would discard the state file destroy needs for
83: 	// its management network cleanup on the next attempt.
84: 	failedLabDirs := map[string]bool{}
85: 
86: 	defer func() {
87: 		if opts.cleanup {
88: 			if cleanupErr := c.destroyLabDirs(topos, opts.all, failedLabDirs); cleanupErr != nil {
89: 				err = errors.Join(err, cleanupErr)
90: 			}
91: 		}
92: 	}()
93: 
94: 	if len(topos) == 0 {
95: 		return nil
96: 	}
97: 
98: 	log.Debugf("got the following topologies for destroy: %+v", topos)
99: 
100: 	// if all, and cli doesn't have --yes flag, and in a terminal -- prompt user confirmation
101: 	if opts.all && opts.terminalPrompt && term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdin.Fd())) {
102: 		err := cliPromptToDestroyAll(topos)
103: 		if err != nil {
104: 			return err
105: 		}
106: 	}
107: 
108: 	var errs []error
109: 
110: 	for topo, labDir := range topos {
111: 		cc, err := c.makeCopyForDestroy(ctx, topo, labDir, *opts)
112: 		if err != nil {
113: 			log.Errorf("error creating clab instance for topo %q: %v", topo, err)
114: 
115: 			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf(
116: 				"error creating clab instance for topo %q: %w", topo, err))
117: 			failedLabDirs[labDir] = true
118: 
119: 			continue
120: 		}
121: 
122: 		err = cc.destroy(ctx, opts.maxWorkers, opts.keepMgmtNet)
123: 		if err != nil {
124: 			log.Errorf("Error occurred during the %s lab deletion: %v", cc.Config.Name, err)
125: 			errs = append(errs, err)
126: 			failedLabDirs[labDir] = true
127: 		}
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if len(errs) != 0 {
131: 		return fmt.Errorf("error(s) occurred during the deletion. Check log messages")
132: 	}
133: 
134: 	return nil
135: }
136: 
137: // creates a mostly cloned version of the current c but set to the new topology, and with the
138: // necessary steps (mgmt network things) handled preparing the new CLab for destruction.
139: func (c *CLab) makeCopyForDestroy(
140: 	ctx context.Context,
141: 	topo,
142: 	labDir string,
143: 	opts DestroyOptions,
144: ) (*CLab, error) {
145: 	newOpts := []ClabOption{
146: 		WithTimeout(c.timeout),
147: 		// a topology edited after deploy may no longer pass the mgmt-net link checks,
148: 		// which must not prevent the removal of the deployed lab.
149: 		WithSkippedMgmtNetLinksCheck(),
150: 	}
151: 
152: 	// the copy must expand the topology with the same env vars as the deployment did
153: 	if c.topologyEnv != nil {
154: 		newOpts = append(newOpts, WithTopologyEnv(c.topologyEnv))
155: 	}
156: 
157: 	// Try to load topology file if it exists, otherwise use lab name only.
158: 	// This allows destroying labs even when the topology file has been deleted.
159: 	// WithTopoPath / WithLabNameOnly must run before WithNodeFilter so filterClabNodes
160: 	// sees topology nodes (see filterClabNodes in clab.go).
161: 	varsFiles := opts.varsFiles
162: 	if len(varsFiles) == 0 {
163: 		varsFiles = c.TopoPaths.VarsFilenamesAbsPath()
164: 	}
165: 
166: 	if clabutils.FileOrDirExists(topo) {
167: 		newOpts = append(newOpts, WithTopoPath(topo, varsFiles))
168: 	} else {
169: 		// Derive lab name from lab directory (format: clab-<labname>)
170: 		labName := filepath.Base(labDir)
171: 		labName = strings.TrimPrefix(labName, "clab-")
172: 		log.Debugf("topology file %q not found, using lab name %q for destroy", topo, labName)
173: 		newOpts = append(newOpts, WithLabNameOnly(labName))
174: 	}
175: 
176: 	newOpts = append(newOpts,
177: 		WithNodeFilter(opts.nodeFilter),
178: 		// during destroy we don't want to check bind paths
179: 		// as it is irrelevant for this command.
180: 		WithSkippedBindsPathsCheck(),
181: 		WithRuntime(
182: 			c.globalRuntimeName,
183: 			&clabruntime.RuntimeConfig{
184: 				Debug:            c.Config.Debug,
185: 				Timeout:          c.timeout,
186: 				GracefulShutdown: opts.graceful,
187: 			},
188: 		),
189: 	)
190: 
191: 	if opts.keepMgmtNet {
192: 		newOpts = append(newOpts, WithKeepMgmtNet())
193: 	}
194: 
195: 	cc, err := NewContainerLab(newOpts...)
196: 	if err != nil {
197: 		return nil, err
198: 	}
199: 	if labDir != "" && clabutils.FileOrDirExists(labDir) {
200: 		// adjust the labdir. Usually we take the PWD. but now on destroy time,
201: 		// we might be in a different Dir.
202: 		err = cc.TopoPaths.SetLabDir(labDir)
203: 		if err != nil {
204: 			return nil, err
205: 		}
206: 	}
207: 
208: 	// populate the management network state (bridge names) destroy needs for the
209: 	// removal of the iptables rules, without creating networks that are missing:
210: 	// a lab deployed with a management network override leaves the topology's
211: 	// default network uncreated, and creating it here would collide with the
212: 	// subnets the override is using.
213: 	if !cc.mgmtNetworksSkipped() {
214: 		var bridged clabtypes.MgmtNetworks
215: 		for _, m := range cc.allMgmtNetworks() {
216: 			if m.Driver != clabtypes.MgmtDriverMacvlan {
217: 				bridged = append(bridged, m)
218: 			}
219: 		}
220: 		if err = cc.resolveExistingMgmtNetworks(ctx, bridged); err != nil {
221: 			return nil, err
222: 		}
223: 	}
224: 
225: 	err = cc.setMgmtNetLinkBridges()
226: 	if err != nil {
227: 		return nil, err
228: 	}
229: 
230: 	err = cc.ResolveLinks()
231: 	if err != nil {
232: 		return nil, err
233: 	}
234: 
235: 	return cc, nil
236: }
237: 
238: // resolveExistingMgmtNetworks inspects the management networks that already exist
239: // so their bridge names are populated, e.g. for the iptables cleanup on destroy.
240: // Networks that do not exist are skipped: they hold no bridge yet, and the callers
241: // must not create management networks. Runtimes that cannot check network existence
242: // keep the create-or-inspect behavior.
243: func (c *CLab) resolveExistingMgmtNetworks(
244: 	ctx context.Context,
245: 	networks clabtypes.MgmtNetworks,
246: ) error {
247: 	var existing clabtypes.MgmtNetworks
248: 
249: 	for _, m := range networks {
250: 		rt, rtErr := c.mgmtRuntime(c.globalRuntimeName, m)
251: 		if rtErr != nil {
252: 			// runtimes without multiple network support never created extra networks
253: 			log.Debug(
254: 				"Skipping management network resolution", "network", m.Network, "error", rtErr,
255: 			)
256: 			continue
257: 		}
258: 
259: 		checker, ok := rt.(clabruntime.MgmtNetworkChecker)
260: 		if !ok {
261: 			existing = append(existing, m)
262: 			continue
263: 		}
264: 
265: 		exists, err := checker.MgmtNetworkExists(ctx)
266: 		if err != nil {
267: 			return err
268: 		}
269: 		if !exists {
270: 			log.Debug("Skipping management network that does not exist", "network", m.Network)
271: 			continue
272: 		}
273: 
274: 		existing = append(existing, m)
275: 	}
276: 
277: 	return c.createNetworks(ctx, existing)
278: }
279: 
280: // destroyLabDirs removes the lab directories of the destroyed labs. Directories
281: // recorded in failedLabDirs are kept: their labs are still running, and the
282: // directory holds the lab state a later destroy attempt relies on.
283: func (c *CLab) destroyLabDirs(
284: 	topos map[string]string,
285: 	all bool,
286: 	failedLabDirs map[string]bool,
287: ) error {
288: 	if len(topos) == 0 {
289: 		log.Info("no containerlab containers found")
290: 
291: 		if !all {
292: 			labDir := c.TopoPaths.TopologyLabDir()
293: 			if labDir == "" {
294: 				// Try to infer the precise lab directory when TopologyLabDir is not set,
295: 				// e.g. destroy --name without topology file. Only look for an exact
296: 				// clab-<name> match, never a wildcard.
297: 				if c.Config != nil && c.Config.Name != "" {
298: 					candidates := []string{}
299: 					if base := os.Getenv("CLAB_LABDIR_BASE"); base != "" {
300: 						candidates = append(candidates, filepath.Join(base, "clab-"+c.Config.Name))
301: 					}
302: 					if c.TopoPaths.TopologyFileIsSet() {
303: 						candidates = append(
304: 							candidates,
305: 							filepath.Join(c.TopoPaths.TopologyFileDir(), "clab-"+c.Config.Name),
306: 						)
307: 					} else {
308: 						if wd, err := os.Getwd(); err == nil && wd != "" {
309: 							candidates = append(
310: 								candidates,
311: 								filepath.Join(wd, "clab-"+c.Config.Name),
312: 							)
313: 						}
314: 					}
315: 					for _, cand := range candidates {
316: 						if _, err := os.Stat(cand); err == nil {
317: 							labDir = cand
318: 							break
319: 						}
320: 					}
321: 					if labDir == "" {
322: 						log.Info(
323: 							"lab directory not found, nothing to clean",
324: 							"candidates",
325: 							candidates,
326: 						)
327: 						return nil
328: 					}
329: 				} else {
330: 					log.Info("lab directory not found, nothing to clean")
331: 					return nil
332: 				}
333: 			}
334: 
335: 			// Safety: only remove directories that look like a lab directory.
336: 			base := filepath.Base(labDir)
337: 			if !strings.HasPrefix(base, "clab-") {
338: 				log.Warnf("refusing to remove lab directory %q: unexpected name", labDir)
339: 				return nil
340: 			}
341: 			if c.Config != nil && c.Config.Name != "" {
342: 				expected := "clab-" + c.Config.Name
343: 				if base != expected {
344: 					log.Warnf(
345: 						"refusing to remove lab directory %q: does not match expected %q",
346: 						labDir,
347: 						expected,
348: 					)
349: 					return nil
350: 				}
351: 			}
352: 
353: 			if _, err := os.Stat(labDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
354: 				log.Info("lab directory not found, nothing to clean", "path", labDir)
355: 				return nil
356: 			} else if err != nil {
357: 				log.Debug("failed to stat lab directory, skipping", "path", labDir, "error", err)
358: 				return nil
359: 			}
360: 
361: 			log.Info("Removing lab directory", "path", labDir)
362: 			if err := os.RemoveAll(labDir); err != nil {
363: 				log.Errorf("error deleting lab directory: %v", err)
364: 				return err
365: 			}
366: 		}
367: 
368: 		return nil
369: 	}
370: 
371: 	for _, labdir := range topos {
372: 		if failedLabDirs[labdir] {
373: 			log.Warnf(
374: 				"keeping lab directory %s: the lab was not destroyed, so its state is kept for a later attempt",
375: 				labdir,
376: 			)
377: 
378: 			continue
379: 		}
380: 
381: 		err := os.RemoveAll(labdir)
382: 		if err != nil {
383: 			log.Errorf("error deleting lab directory: %v", err)
384: 		}
385: 	}
386: 
387: 	return nil
388: }
389: 
390: func (c *CLab) destroy(ctx context.Context, maxWorkers uint, keepMgmtNet bool) error {
391: 	var containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer
392: 	var orphanSidecars []clabruntime.GenericContainer
393: 	var err error
394: 
395: 	// If we have nodes defined (from topology file), list containers by node.
396: 	// Otherwise, list containers by lab name label (for destroy-by-name-only case).
397: 	if len(c.Nodes) > 0 {
398: 		containers, err = c.ListNodesContainersIgnoreNotFound(ctx)
399: 	} else if c.Config.Name != "" {
400: 		containers, err = c.ListContainers(ctx, WithListLabName(c.Config.Name))
401: 	}
402: 
403: 	if err != nil {
404: 		return err
405: 	}
406: 
407: 	if len(c.Nodes) == 0 {
408: 		c.addMgmtNetworksFromContainers(containers)
409: 	}
410: 
411: 	if len(c.Nodes) > 0 {
412: 		tailscaleContainers, err := c.discoverTailscaleContainers(ctx, c.nodeFilter)
413: 		if err != nil {
414: 			return err
415: 		}
416: 		for _, ctr := range tailscaleContainers {
417: 			if _, desired := c.Nodes[ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName]]; desired {
418: 				continue
419: 			}
420: 			containers = append(containers, ctr)
421: 			if ctr.Labels[clabconstants.ToolType] == "" {
422: 				orphanSidecars = append(orphanSidecars, ctr)
423: 			}
424: 		}
425: 	}
426: 
427: 	if len(containers) == 0 {
428: 		if len(c.Nodes) > 0 && len(c.Links) > 0 {
429: 			c.deleteSpecialLinkNodes(ctx)
430: 		}
431: 		return nil
432: 	}
433: 
434: 	if maxWorkers == 0 {
435: 		maxWorkers = uint(len(containers))
436: 	}
437: 
438: 	log.Info("Destroying lab", "name", c.Config.Name)
439: 
440: 	// If we have nodes defined, use the normal node-based deletion.
441: 	// Otherwise, delete containers directly via the runtime (for destroy-by-name-only case).
442: 	if len(c.Nodes) > 0 {
443: 		c.preDestroyNodes(ctx, slices.Collect(maps.Values(c.Nodes)), maxWorkers)
444: 
445: 		err := clablinks.CleanupFilteredLinks(
446: 			ctx,
447: 			c.Config.Topology.Links,
448: 			c.Config.Name,
449: 			c.nodeFilter,
450: 		)
451: 		if err != nil {
452: 			return err
453: 		}
454: 		c.deleteNodes(ctx, maxWorkers)
455: 		c.deleteLeftoverLabContainers(ctx)
456: 		c.deleteContainersDirect(ctx, orphanSidecars)
457: 	} else {
458: 		c.deleteContainersDirect(ctx, containers)
459: 	}
460: 
461: 	c.deleteToolContainers(ctx)
462: 
463: 	log.Info("Removing host entries", "path", "/etc/hosts")
464: 
465: 	err = c.DeleteEntriesFromHostsFile()
466: 	if err != nil {
467: 		return fmt.Errorf("error while trying to clean up the hosts file: %w", err)
468: 	}
469: 
470: 	log.Info("Removing SSH config", "path", c.TopoPaths.SSHConfigPath())
471: 
472: 	err = c.RemoveSSHConfig(c.TopoPaths)
473: 	if err != nil {
474: 		log.Errorf("failed to remove ssh config file: %v", err)
475: 	}
476: 
477: 	// delete container network namespaces symlinks
478: 	for _, node := range c.Nodes {
479: 		err = node.DeleteNetnsSymlink()
480: 		if err != nil {
481: 			return fmt.Errorf("error while deleting netns symlinks: %w", err)
482: 		}
483: 	}
484: 
485: 	// Sweep this lab's leftover parking netns entries. Destroyed labs have
486: 	// nothing left to migrate or restore, so entries abandoned by an
487: 	// interrupted bridge-port migration are removed, parked ports included.
488: 	// Candidates are the deploy nodes plus every node recorded in the lab
489: 	// state, so slots of bridges that left the topology still get swept.
490: 	longNames := make([]string, 0, len(c.Nodes))
491: 	for _, node := range c.Nodes {
492: 		if cfg := node.Config(); cfg != nil {
493: 			longNames = append(longNames, cfg.LongName)
494: 		}
495: 	}
496: 
497: 	state, err := c.LoadState()
498: 	switch {
499: 	case err != nil:
500: 		// Mirror the management-network cleanup wording; a missing state only
501: 		// narrows the sweep to the current topology's nodes.
502: 		log.Debug("Unable to load the parking netns entries recorded in the lab state", "error", err)
503: 	case state != nil && state.Topology != nil:
504: 		// Slots of nodes that left the topology since the last deploy still
505: 		// get swept through the recorded state.
506: 		for nodeName := range state.Topology.Nodes {
507: 			longNames = append(longNames, fmt.Sprintf("clab-%s-%s", c.Config.Name, nodeName))
508: 		}
509: 	}
510: 
511: 	if err := clabutils.SweepParkingNetnses(longNames...); err != nil {
512: 		log.Warnf("failed to clean up parking namespaces: %v", err)
513: 	}
514: 
515: 	// delete every defined management network, including extra networks
516: 	// that apply may have left without nodes, and networks a previous
517: 	// deployment recorded in the lab state but the topology no longer defines
518: 	for _, m := range c.mgmtNetworksForCleanup() {
519: 		if m.Network == "bridge" || keepMgmtNet {
520: 			continue
521: 		}
522: 		log.Debugf("Calling DeleteNet method. Management network value is: %+v", m)
523: 
524: 		rt, rtErr := c.mgmtRuntime(c.globalRuntimeName, m)
525: 		if rtErr != nil {
526: 			// runtimes without multiple network support never created extra networks
527: 			log.Debug("Skipping management network deletion", "network", m.Network, "error", rtErr)
528: 			continue
529: 		}
530: 		if err = rt.DeleteNet(ctx); err != nil {
531: 			switch {
532: 			case err.Error() == fmt.Sprintf("Error: No such network: %s", m.Network):
533: 			case strings.Contains(err.Error(), fmt.Sprintf(" network %s not found", m.Network)):
534: 			default:
535: 				log.Error(err)
536: 			}
537: 		}
538: 	}
539: 
540: 	return nil
541: }
542: 
543: func (c *CLab) addMgmtNetworksFromContainers(containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer) {
544: 	for _, ctr := range containers {
545: 		switch name := ctr.NetworkName; name {
546: 		case "", "unknown", "bridge", "host", "none":
547: 		default:
548: 			if c.mgmtNetByNetwork(name).Network == name {
549: 				continue
550: 			}
551: 			c.Config.MgmtNetworks = append(c.Config.MgmtNetworks, &clabtypes.MgmtNet{
552: 				Network:        name,
553: 				Bridge:         ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeMgmtNetBr],
554: 				ExternalAccess: new(true),
555: 			})
556: 		}
557: 	}
558: }
559: 
560: // mgmtNetworksForCleanup returns the management networks to delete on destroy:
561: // the topology-defined ones plus any network a previous deployment recorded in
562: // the lab state but that the current topology no longer defines. Without the
563: // state record a network dropped from the mgmt list would never be removed.
564: func (c *CLab) mgmtNetworksForCleanup() clabtypes.MgmtNetworks {
565: 	networks := c.allMgmtNetworks()
566: 
567: 	state, err := c.LoadState()
568: 	if err != nil {
569: 		log.Warn("Unable to load the management networks recorded in the lab state", "error", err)
570: 		return networks
571: 	}
572: 	if state == nil {
573: 		return networks
574: 	}
575: 
576: 	defined := make(map[string]bool, len(networks))
577: 	for _, m := range networks {
578: 		defined[m.Network] = true
579: 	}
580: 	for _, name := range state.MgmtNetworks {
581: 		if defined[name] {
582: 			continue
583: 		}
584: 		defined[name] = true
585: 		// ExternalAccess mirrors the default every management network gets, so
586: 		// the forwarding rule installed for the network is cleaned up too.
587: 		networks = append(networks, &clabtypes.MgmtNet{
588: 			Network:        name,
589: 			ExternalAccess: new(true),
590: 		})
591: 	}
592: 
593: 	return networks
594: }
595: 
596: func (c *CLab) deleteApplyNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {
597: 	nodeNames := make([]string, 0, len(plan.deletedNodeSet)+len(plan.recreatedNodeSet))
598: 	for nodeName := range plan.deletedNodeSet {
599: 		nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
600: 	}
601: 	for nodeName := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {
602: 		nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
603: 	}
604: 	sort.Strings(nodeNames)
605: 
606: 	hookNodes := make([]clabnodes.Node, 0, len(nodeNames))
607: 	var tailscaleContainers []clabruntime.GenericContainer
608: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
609: 		runtimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]
610: 		if runtimeNode == nil {
611: 			return fmt.Errorf("runtime node %q not found", nodeName)
612: 		}
613: 		if runtimeNode.external || runtimeNode.rootNamespaceBased {
614: 			continue
615: 		}
616: 		if len(runtimeNode.containers) > 0 &&
617: 			runtimeNode.containers[0].Labels[clabconstants.NodeKind] == clabnodestailscale.KindName {
618: 			tailscaleContainers = append(tailscaleContainers, runtimeNode.containers...)
619: 			continue
620: 		}
621: 		if node, ok := c.Nodes[nodeName]; ok {
622: 			hookNodes = append(hookNodes, node)
623: 		}
624: 	}
625: 	var logoutWg sync.WaitGroup
626: 	for _, ctr := range tailscaleContainers {
627: 		logoutWg.Go(func() { c.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, ctr) })
628: 	}
629: 	c.preDestroyNodes(ctx, hookNodes, 0)
630: 	logoutWg.Wait()
631: 
632: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
633: 		runtimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]
634: 		if runtimeNode.external || runtimeNode.rootNamespaceBased {
635: 			continue
636: 		}
637: 
638: 		for i := len(runtimeNode.containers) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
639: 			ctr := runtimeNode.containers[i]
640: 			if len(ctr.Names) == 0 {
641: 				return fmt.Errorf("runtime container for node %q has no name", nodeName)
642: 			}
643: 
644: 			runtime := ctr.Runtime
645: 			if runtime == nil {
646: 				runtime = c.globalRuntime()
647: 			}
648: 
649: 			action := "Deleting node"
650: 			if _, recreate := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreate {
651: 				action = "Deleting node for recreate"
652: 			}
653: 			log.Info(action, "node", nodeName, "container", ctr.Names[0])
654: 			if err := runtime.DeleteContainer(ctx, ctr.Names[0]); err != nil {
655: 				return fmt.Errorf("failed deleting node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
656: 			}
657: 
658: 			_ = clabutils.DeleteNetnsSymlink(ctr.Names[0])
659: 		}
660: 	}
661: 
662: 	return nil
663: }

665: // preDestroyNodes runs the PreDestroy stage of the given nodes concurrently, before any of them
666: // is deleted. Nodes without a container are skipped. A workers value of 0 runs all hooks at once.
667: func (*CLab) preDestroyNodes(ctx context.Context, nodes []clabnodes.Node, workers uint) {
668: 	if workers == 0 || workers > uint(len(nodes)) {
669: 		workers = uint(len(nodes))
670: 	}
671: 
672: 	sem := make(chan struct{}, workers)
673: 	wg := new(sync.WaitGroup)
674: 
675: 	for _, n := range nodes {
676: 		wg.Add(1)
677: 		sem <- struct{}{}
678: 
679: 		go func() {
680: 			defer wg.Done()
681: 			defer func() { <-sem }()
682: 
683: 			if n.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {
684: 				return
685: 			}
686: 
687: 			if err := n.PreDestroy(ctx); err != nil {
688: 				log.Warnf("node %q pre-destroy hook failed: %v", n.Config().ShortName, err)
689: 			}
690: 		}()
691: 	}
692: 
693: 	wg.Wait()
694: }
695: 
696: func (c *CLab) deleteNodes(ctx context.Context, workers uint) {
697: 	wg := new(sync.WaitGroup)
698: 
699: 	concurrentChan := make(chan clabnodes.Node)
700: 
701: 	workerFunc := func(i uint, input chan clabnodes.Node, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {
702: 		defer wg.Done()
703: 
704: 		for {
705: 			select {
706: 			case n := <-input:
707: 				if n == nil {
708: 					log.Debugf("Worker %d terminating...", i)
709: 					return
710: 				}
711: 
712: 				err := n.Delete(ctx)
713: 				if err != nil {
714: 					log.Errorf("could not remove container %q: %v", n.Config().LongName, err)
715: 				}
716: 			case <-ctx.Done():
717: 				return
718: 			}
719: 		}
720: 	}
721: 
722: 	// start concurrent workers
723: 	wg.Add(int(workers))
724: 
725: 	for i := range workers {
726: 		go workerFunc(i, concurrentChan, wg)
727: 	}
728: 
729: 	// send nodes to workers
730: 	for _, n := range c.Nodes {
731: 		concurrentChan <- n
732: 	}
733: 
734: 	// close channel to terminate the workers
735: 	close(concurrentChan)
736: 
737: 	wg.Wait()
738: 
739: 	// Host and mgmt-br links must be removed only after node workers finish.
740: 	// vxlan-stitch teardown deletes veth pairs from containers concurrently with
741: 	// host-namespace VXLAN interfaces; running both at once races netlink deletes.
742: 	c.deleteSpecialLinkNodes(ctx)
743: }
744: 
745: func (c *CLab) deleteSpecialLinkNodes(ctx context.Context) {
746: 	specialNodes := append(
747: 		[]clablinks.Node{clablinks.GetHostLinkNode()},
748: 		clablinks.GetMgmtBrLinkNodes()...,
749: 	)
750: 	for _, n := range specialNodes {
751: 		err := n.Delete(ctx)
752: 		if err != nil {
753: 			log.Warn(err)
754: 		}
755: 	}
756: }

758: // deleteContainersDirect deletes containers directly via the runtime API.
759: // This is used when we don't have node objects (e.g., destroy-by-name-only case).
760: func (c *CLab) deleteContainersDirect(
761: 	ctx context.Context,
762: 	containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer,
763: ) {
764: 	for _, cont := range containers {
765: 		if len(cont.Names) == 0 {
766: 			log.Warnf("skipping container %s with no names", cont.ID)
767: 			continue
768: 		}
769: 		name := cont.Names[0]
770: 		log.Infof("Removing container: %s", name)
771: 
772: 		c.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, cont)
773: 		rt := cont.Runtime
774: 		if rt == nil {
775: 			rt = c.globalRuntime()
776: 		}
777: 		err := rt.DeleteContainer(ctx, name)
778: 		if err != nil {
779: 			log.Errorf("could not remove container %q: %v", name, err)
780: 		}
781: 	}
782: }

784: // deleteLeftoverLabContainers removes containers labeled for this lab whose
785: // node is not part of the rendered topology. Deployments made with different
786: // template variables, or nodes removed from the topology since, leave such
787: // containers behind: topology-based destroy only deletes nodes of the rendered
788: // node set, so these leftovers would survive every destroy otherwise.
789: //
790: // The sweep is skipped for node-filtered destroys (the filter deliberately
791: // keeps non-selected nodes; nothing outside the filtered set may be removed)
792: // and for tool containers (they are the deleteToolContainers flow's own
793: // responsibility).
794: func (c *CLab) deleteLeftoverLabContainers(ctx context.Context) {
795: 	if len(c.nodeFilter) > 0 {
796: 		log.Debug("Skipping lab leftover sweeps: destroy is node-filtered; non-selected containers must be preserved")
797: 		return
798: 	}
799: 
800: 	containers, err := c.ListContainers(ctx, WithListLabName(c.Config.Name))
801: 	if err != nil {
802: 		log.Warnf("Failed to list containers for the lab leftover sweep: %v", err)
803: 		return
804: 	}
805: 
806: 	ownedByTopology := make(map[string]struct{}, len(c.Nodes))
807: 	for _, node := range c.Nodes {
808: 		if cfg := node.Config(); cfg != nil {
809: 			ownedByTopology[cfg.LongName] = struct{}{}
810: 		}
811: 	}
812: 
813: 	rt := c.globalRuntime()
814: 
815: 	for _, cont := range containers {
816: 		if len(cont.Names) == 0 {
817: 			continue
818: 		}
819: 		if _, owned := ownedByTopology[cont.Names[0]]; owned {
820: 			continue
821: 		}
822: 		if cont.Labels[clabconstants.ToolType] != "" {
823: 			continue
824: 		}
825: 
826: 		log.Warnf("Removing leftover container %q; its node is not part of the rendered topology",
827: 			cont.Names[0])
828: 
829: 		if err := rt.DeleteContainer(ctx, cont.Names[0]); err != nil {
830: 			log.Errorf("could not remove leftover container %q: %v", cont.Names[0], err)
831: 		}
832: 	}
833: }

835: func (c *CLab) deleteToolContainers(ctx context.Context) {
836: 	toolTypes := []string{"sshx", "gotty"}
837: 	if len(c.nodeFilter) == 0 {
838: 		toolTypes = append(toolTypes, clabnodestailscale.ToolType)
839: 	}
840: 
841: 	for _, toolType := range toolTypes {
842: 		toolFilter := []*clabtypes.GenericFilter{
843: 			{
844: 				FilterType: "label",
845: 				Field:      clabconstants.ToolType,
846: 				Operator:   "=",
847: 				Match:      toolType,
848: 			},
849: 			{
850: 				FilterType: "label",
851: 				Field:      clabconstants.Containerlab,
852: 				Operator:   "=",
853: 				Match:      c.Config.Name,
854: 			},
855: 		}
856: 
857: 		containers, err := c.globalRuntime().ListContainers(ctx, toolFilter)
858: 		if err != nil {
859: 			log.Error("Failed to list tool containers", "tool", toolType, "error", err)
860: 			continue
861: 		}
862: 
863: 		if len(containers) == 0 {
864: 			log.Debug("No tool containers found for lab", "tool", toolType, "lab", c.Config.Name)
865: 			continue
866: 		}
867: 
868: 		log.Info("Found tool containers associated with a lab", "tool", toolType, "lab",
869: 			c.Config.Name, "count", len(containers))
870: 
871: 		for idx := range containers {
872: 			containerName := strings.TrimPrefix(containers[idx].Names[0], "/")
873: 
874: 			log.Info("Removing tool container", "tool", toolType, "container", containerName)
875: 
876: 			c.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, containers[idx])
877: 			if err := c.globalRuntime().DeleteContainer(ctx, containerName); err != nil {
878: 				log.Error("Failed to remove tool container", "tool", toolType,
879: 					"container", containerName, "error", err)
880: 			} else {
881: 				log.Info(
882: 					"Tool container removed successfully",
883: 					"tool",
884: 					toolType,
885: 					"container",
886: 					containerName,
887: 				)
888: 			}
889: 		}
890: 	}
891: }

893: func cliPromptToDestroyAll(topos map[string]string) error {
894: 	var sb strings.Builder
895: 
896: 	idx := 1
897: 
898: 	for topo, labDir := range topos {
899: 		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. Topology: %s\n     Lab Dir: %s\n", idx, topo, labDir))
900: 		idx++
901: 	}
902: 
903: 	log.Warn("The following labs will be removed:", "labs", sb.String())
904: 
905: 	// red color (ansi code 1)
906: 	warningStyle := lipgloss.NewStyle().Bold(true).Foreground(lipgloss.Color("1"))
907: 	prompt := "Are you sure you want to remove all labs listed above? Enter 'y'," +
908: 		" to confirm or ENTER to abort: "
909: 	fmt.Print(warningStyle.Render(prompt))
910: 
911: 	reader := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
912: 
913: 	input, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
914: 	if err != nil {
915: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read user input: %v", err)
916: 	}
917: 
918: 	answer := strings.TrimSpace(input)
919: 	if answer == "" {
920: 		return errors.New("aborted by the user. No labs were removed")
921: 	}
922: 
923: 	answer = strings.ToLower(answer)
924: 	if answer != "y" && answer != "yes" {
925: 		return errors.New("aborted by the user. No labs were removed")
926: 	}
927: 
928: 	return nil
929: }

base := os.Getenv(\"CLAB_LABDIR_BASE\"); base != \"\" {\n300: \t\t\t\t\t\tcandidates = append(candidates, filepath.Join(base, \"clab-\"+c.Config.Name))\n301: \t\t\t\t\t}\n302: \t\t\t\t\tif c.TopoPaths.TopologyFileIsSet() {\n303: \t\t\t\t\t\tcandidates = append(\n304: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tcandidates,\n305: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tfilepath.Join(c.TopoPaths.TopologyFileDir(), \"clab-\"+c.Config.Name),\n306: \t\t\t\t\t\t)\n307: \t\t\t\t\t} else {\n308: \t\t\t\t\t\tif wd, err := os.Getwd(); err == nil && wd != \"\" {\n309: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tcandidates = append(\n310: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcandidates,\n311: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tfilepath.Join(wd, \"clab-\"+c.Config.Name),\n312: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t)\n313: \t\t\t\t\t\t}\n314: \t\t\t\t\t}\n315: \t\t\t\t\tfor _, cand := range candidates {\n316: \t\t\t\t\t\tif _, err := os.Stat(cand); err == nil {\n317: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tlabDir = cand\n318: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tbreak\n319: \t\t\t\t\t\t}\n320: \t\t\t\t\t}\n321: \t\t\t\t\tif labDir == \"\" {\n322: \t\t\t\t\t\tlog.Info(\n323: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"lab directory not found, nothing to clean\",\n324: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"candidates\",\n325: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tcandidates,\n326: \t\t\t\t\t\t)\n327: \t\t\t\t\t\treturn nil\n328: \t\t\t\t\t}\n329: \t\t\t\t} else {\n330: \t\t\t\t\tlog.Info(\"lab directory not found, nothing to clean\")\n331: \t\t\t\t\treturn nil\n332: \t\t\t\t}\n333: \t\t\t}\n334: \n335: \t\t\t// Safety: only remove directories that look like a lab directory.\n336: \t\t\tbase := filepath.Base(labDir)\n337: \t\t\tif !strings.HasPrefix(base, \"clab-\") {\n338: \t\t\t\tlog.Warnf(\"refusing to remove lab directory %q: unexpected name\", labDir)\n339: \t\t\t\treturn nil\n340: \t\t\t}\n341: \t\t\tif c.Config != nil && c.Config.Name != \"\" {\n342: \t\t\t\texpected := \"clab-\" + c.Config.Name\n343: \t\t\t\tif base != expected {\n344: \t\t\t\t\tlog.Warnf(\n345: \t\t\t\t\t\t\"refusing to remove lab directory %q: does not match expected %q\",\n346: \t\t\t\t\t\tlabDir,\n347: \t\t\t\t\t\texpected,\n348: \t\t\t\t\t)\n349: \t\t\t\t\treturn nil\n350: \t\t\t\t}\n351: \t\t\t}\n352: \n353: \t\t\tif _, err := os.Stat(labDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {\n354: \t\t\t\tlog.Info(\"lab directory not found, nothing to clean\", \"path\", labDir)\n355: \t\t\t\treturn nil\n356: \t\t\t} else if err != nil {\n357: \t\t\t\tlog.Debug(\"failed to stat lab directory, skipping\", \"path\", labDir, \"error\", err)\n358: \t\t\t\treturn nil\n359: \t\t\t}\n360: \n361: \t\t\tlog.Info(\"Removing lab directory\", \"path\", labDir)\n362: \t\t\tif err := os.RemoveAll(labDir); err != nil {\n363: \t\t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"error deleting lab directory: %v\", err)\n364: \t\t\t\treturn err\n365: \t\t\t}\n366: \t\t}\n367: \n368: \t\treturn nil\n369: \t}\n370: \n371: \tfor _, labdir := range topos {\n372: \t\tif failedLabDirs[labdir] {\n373: \t\t\tlog.Warnf(\n374: \t\t\t\t\"keeping lab directory %s: the lab was not destroyed, so its state is kept for a later attempt\",\n375: \t\t\t\tlabdir,\n376: \t\t\t)\n377: \n378: \t\t\tcontinue\n379: \t\t}\n380: \n381: \t\terr := os.RemoveAll(labdir)\n382: \t\tif err != nil {\n383: \t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"error deleting lab directory: %v\", err)\n384: \t\t}\n385: \t}\n386: \n387: \treturn nil\n388: }\n389: \n390: func (c *CLab) destroy(ctx context.Context, maxWorkers uint, keepMgmtNet bool) error {\n391: \tvar containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer\n392: \tvar orphanSidecars []clabruntime.GenericContainer\n393: \tvar err error\n394: \n395: \t// If we have nodes defined (from topology file), list containers by node.\n396: \t// Otherwise, list containers by lab name label (for destroy-by-name-only case).\n397: \tif len(c.Nodes) > 0 {\n398: \t\tcontainers, err = c.ListNodesContainersIgnoreNotFound(ctx)\n399: \t} else if c.Config.Name != \"\" {\n400: \t\tcontainers, err = c.ListContainers(ctx, WithListLabName(c.Config.Name))\n401: \t}\n402: \n403: \tif err != nil {\n404: \t\treturn err\n405: \t}\n406: \n407: \tif len(c.Nodes) == 0 {\n408: \t\tc.addMgmtNetworksFromContainers(containers)\n409: \t}\n410: \n411: \tif len(c.Nodes) > 0 {\n412: \t\ttailscaleContainers, err := c.discoverTailscaleContainers(ctx, c.nodeFilter)\n413: \t\tif err != nil {\n414: \t\t\treturn err\n415: \t\t}\n416: \t\tfor _, ctr := range tailscaleContainers {\n417: \t\t\tif _, desired := c.Nodes[ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName]]; desired {\n418: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n419: \t\t\t}\n420: \t\t\tcontainers = append(containers, ctr)\n421: \t\t\tif ctr.Labels[clabconstants.ToolType] == \"\" {\n422: \t\t\t\torphanSidecars = append(orphanSidecars, ctr)\n423: \t\t\t}\n424: \t\t}\n425: \t}\n426: \n427: \tif len(containers) == 0 {\n428: \t\tif len(c.Nodes) > 0 && len(c.Links) > 0 {\n429: \t\t\tc.deleteSpecialLinkNodes(ctx)\n430: \t\t}\n431: \t\treturn nil\n432: \t}\n433: \n434: \tif maxWorkers == 0 {\n435: \t\tmaxWorkers = uint(len(containers))\n436: \t}\n437: \n438: \tlog.Info(\"Destroying lab\", \"name\", c.Config.Name)\n439: \n440: \t// If we have nodes defined, use the normal node-based deletion.\n441: \t// Otherwise, delete containers directly via the runtime (for destroy-by-name-only case).\n442: \tif len(c.Nodes) > 0 {\n443: \t\tc.preDestroyNodes(ctx, slices.Collect(maps.Values(c.Nodes)), maxWorkers)\n444: \n445: \t\terr := clablinks.CleanupFilteredLinks(\n446: \t\t\tctx,\n447: \t\t\tc.Config.Topology.Links,\n448: \t\t\tc.Config.Name,\n449: \t\t\tc.nodeFilter,\n450: \t\t)\n451: \t\tif err != nil {\n452: \t\t\treturn err\n453: \t\t}\n454: \t\tc.deleteNodes(ctx, maxWorkers)\n455: \t\tc.deleteLeftoverLabContainers(ctx)\n456: \t\tc.deleteContainersDirect(ctx, orphanSidecars)\n457: \t} else {\n458: \t\tc.deleteContainersDirect(ctx, containers)\n459: \t}\n460: \n461: \tc.deleteToolContainers(ctx)\n462: \n463: \tlog.Info(\"Removing host entries\", \"path\", \"/etc/hosts\")\n464: \n465: \terr = c.DeleteEntriesFromHostsFile()\n466: \tif err != nil {\n467: \t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"error while trying to clean up the hosts file: %w\", err)\n468: \t}\n469: \n470: \tlog.Info(\"Removing SSH config\", \"path\", c.TopoPaths.SSHConfigPath())\n471: \n472: \terr = c.RemoveSSHConfig(c.TopoPaths)\n473: \tif err != nil {\n474: \t\tlog.Errorf(\"failed to remove ssh config file: %v\", err)\n475: \t}\n476: \n477: \t// delete container network namespaces symlinks\n478: \tfor _, node := range c.Nodes {\n479: \t\terr = node.DeleteNetnsSymlink()\n480: \t\tif err != nil {\n481: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"error while deleting netns symlinks: %w\", err)\n482: \t\t}\n483: \t}\n484: \n485: \t// Sweep this lab's leftover parking netns entries. Destroyed labs have\n486: \t// nothing left to migrate or restore, so entries abandoned by an\n487: \t// interrupted bridge-port migration are removed, parked ports included.\n488: \t// Candidates are the deploy nodes plus every node recorded in the lab\n489: \t// state, so slots of bridges that left the topology still get swept.\n490: \tlongNames := make([]string, 0, len(c.Nodes))\n491: \tfor _, node := range c.Nodes {\n492: \t\tif cfg := node.Config(); cfg != nil {\n493: \t\t\tlongNames = append(longNames, cfg.LongName)\n494: \t\t}\n495: \t}\n496: \n497: \tstate, err := c.LoadState()\n498: \tswitch {\n499: \tcase err != nil:\n500: \t\t// Mirror the management-network cleanup wording; a missing state only\n501: \t\t// narrows the sweep to the current topology's nodes.\n502: \t\tlog.Debug(\"Unable to load the parking netns entries recorded in the lab state\", \"error\", err)\n503: \tcase state != nil && state.Topology != nil:\n504: \t\t// Slots of nodes that left the topology since the last deploy still\n505: \t\t// get swept through the recorded state.\n506: \t\tfor nodeName := range state.Topology.Nodes {\n507: \t\t\tlongNames = append(longNames, fmt.Sprintf(\"clab-%s-%s\", c.Config.Name, nodeName))\n508: \t\t}\n509: \t}\n510: \n511: \tif err := clabutils.SweepParkingNetnses(longNames...); err != nil {\n512: \t\tlog.Warnf(\"failed to clean up parking namespaces: %v\", err)\n513: \t}\n514: \n515: \t// delete every defined management network, including extra networks\n516: \t// that apply may have left without nodes, and networks a previous\n517: \t// deployment recorded in the lab state but the topology no longer defines\n518: \tfor _, m := range c.mgmtNetworksForCleanup() {\n519: \t\tif m.Network == \"bridge\" || keepMgmtNet {\n520: \t\t\tcontinue\n521: \t\t}\n522: \t\tlog.Debugf(\"Calling DeleteNet method. Management network value is: %+v\", m)\n523: \n524: \t\trt, rtErr := c.mgmtRuntime(c.globalRuntimeName, m)\n525: \t\tif rtErr != nil {\n526: \t\t\t// runtimes without multiple network support never created extra networks\n527: \t\t\tlog.Debug(\"Skipping management network deletion\", \"network\", m.Network, \"error\", rtErr)\n528: \t\t\tcontinue\n529: \t\t}\n530: \t\tif err = rt.DeleteNet(ctx); err != nil {\n531: \t\t\tswitch {\n532: \t\t\tcase err.Error() == fmt.Sprintf(\"Error: No such network: %s\", m.Network):\n533: \t\t\tcase strings.Contains(err.Error(), fmt.Sprintf(\" network %s not found\", m.Network)):\n534: \t\t\tdefault:\n535: \t\t\t\tlog.Error(err)\n536: \t\t\t}\n537: \t\t}\n538: \t}\n539: \n540: \treturn nil\n541: }\n542: \n543: func (c *CLab) addMgmtNetworksFromContainers(containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer) {\n544: \tfor _, ctr := range containers {\n545: \t\tswitch name := ctr.NetworkName; name {\n546: \t\tcase \"\", \"unknown\", \"bridge\", \"host\", \"none\":\n547: \t\tdefault:\n548: \t\t\tif c.mgmtNetByNetwork(name).Network == name {\n549: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n550: \t\t\t}\n551: \t\t\tc.Config.MgmtNetworks = append(c.Config.MgmtNetworks, &clabtypes.MgmtNet{\n552: \t\t\t\tNetwork:        name,\n553: \t\t\t\tBridge:         ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeMgmtNetBr],\n554: \t\t\t\tExternalAccess: new(true),\n555: \t\t\t})\n556: \t\t}\n557: \t}\n558: }\n559: \n560: // mgmtNetworksForCleanup returns the management networks to delete on destroy:\n561: // the topology-defined ones plus any network a previous deployment recorded in\n562: // the lab state but that the current topology no longer defines. Without the\n563: // state record a network dropped from the mgmt list would never be removed.\n564: func (c *CLab) mgmtNetworksForCleanup() clabtypes.MgmtNetworks {\n565: \tnetworks := c.allMgmtNetworks()\n566: \n567: \tstate, err := c.LoadState()\n568: \tif err != nil {\n569: \t\tlog.Warn(\"Unable to load the management networks recorded in the lab state\", \"error\", err)\n570: \t\treturn networks\n571: \t}\n572: \tif state == nil {\n573: \t\treturn networks\n574: \t}\n575: \n576: \tdefined := make(map[string]bool, len(networks))\n577: \tfor _, m := range networks {\n578: ExternalAccess mirrors the default every management network gets, so\n586: \t\t// the forwarding rule installed for the network is cleaned up too.\n587: \t\tnetworks = append(networks, &clabtypes.MgmtNet{\n588: \t\t\tNetwork:        name,\n589: \t\t\tExternalAccess: new(true),\n590: \t\t})\n591: \t}\n592: \n593: \treturn networks\n594: }\n595: \n596: func (c *CLab) deleteApplyNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {\n597: \tnodeNames := make([]string, 0, len(plan.deletedNodeSet)+len(plan.recreatedNodeSet))\n598: \tfor nodeName := range plan.deletedNodeSet {\n599: \t\tnodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)\n600: \t}\n601: \tfor nodeName := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {\n602: \t\tnodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)\n603: \t}\n604: \tsort.Strings(nodeNames)\n605: \n606: \thookNodes := make([]clabnodes.Node, 0, len(nodeNames))\n607: \tvar tailscaleContainers []clabruntime.GenericContainer\n608: \tfor _, nodeName := range nodeNames {\n609: \t\truntimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]\n610: \t\tif runtimeNode == nil {\n611: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"runtime node %q not found\", nodeName)\n612: \t\t}\n613: \t\tif runtimeNode.external || runtimeNode.rootNamespaceBased {\n614: \t\t\tcontinue\n615: \t\t}\n616: \t\tif len(runtimeNode.containers) > 0 &&\n617: \t\t\truntimeNode.containers[0].Labels[clabconstants.NodeKind] == clabnodestailscale.KindName {\n618: \t\t\ttailscaleContainers = append(tailscaleContainers, runtimeNode.containers...)\n619: \t\t\tcontinue\n620: \t\t}\n621: \t\tif node, ok := c.Nodes[nodeName]; ok {\n622: \t\t\thookNodes = append(hookNodes, node)\n623: \t\t}\n624: \t}\n625: \tvar logoutWg sync.WaitGroup\n626: \tfor _, ctr := range tailscaleContainers {\n627: \t\tlogoutWg.Go(func() { c.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, ctr) })\n628: \t}\n629: \tc.preDestroyNodes(ctx, hookNodes, 0)\n630: \tlogoutWg.Wait()\n631: \n632: \tfor _, nodeName := range nodeNames {\n633: \t\truntimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]\n634: \t\tif runtimeNode.external || runtimeNode.rootNamespaceBased {\n635: \t\t\tcontinue\n636: \t\t}\n637: \n638: \t\tfor i := len(runtimeNode.containers) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {\n639: \t\t\tctr := runtimeNode.containers[i]\n640: \t\t\tif len(ctr.Names) == 0 {\n641: \t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"runtime container for node %q has no name\", nodeName)\n642: \t\t\t}\n643: \n644: \t\t\truntime := ctr.Runtime\n645: \t\t\tif runtime == nil {\n646: \t\t\t\truntime = c.globalRuntime()\n647: \t\t\t}\n648: \n649: \t\t\taction := \"Deleting node\"\n650: \t\t\tif _, recreate := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreate {\n651: \t\t\t\taction = \"Deleting node for recreate\"\n652: \t\t\t}\n653: \t\t\tlog.Info(action, \"node\", nodeName, \"container\", ctr.Names[0])\n654: \t\t\tif err := runtime.DeleteContainer(ctx, ctr.Names[0]); err != nil {\n655: \t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed deleting node %q: %w\", nodeName, err)\n656: \t\t\t}\n657: \n658: \t\t\t_ = clabutils.DeleteNetnsSymlink(ctr.Names[0])\n659: \t\t}\n660: \t}\n661: \n662: \treturn nil\n663: }\n664: \n665: // preDestroyNodes runs the PreDestroy stage of the given nodes concurrently, before any of them\n666: // is deleted. Nodes without a container are skipped. A workers value of 0 runs all hooks at once.\n667: func (*CLab) preDestroyNodes(ctx context.Context, nodes []clabnodes.Node, workers uint) {\n668: \tif workers == 0 || workers > uint(len(nodes)) {\n669: \t\tworkers = uint(len(nodes))\n670: \t}\n671: \n672: \tsem := make(chan struct{}, workers)\n673: \twg := new(sync.WaitGroup)\n674: \n675: \tfor _, n := range nodes {\n676: \t\twg.Add(1)\n677: \t\tsem <- struct{}{}\n678: \n679: \t\tgo func() {\n680: \t\t\tdefer wg.Done()\n681: \t\t\tdefer func() { <-sem }()\n682: \n683: \t\t\tif n.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {\n684: \t\t\t\treturn\n685: \t\t\t}\n686: \n687: \t\t\tif err := n.PreDestroy(ctx); err != nil {\n688: \t\t\t\tlog.Warnf(\"node %q pre-destroy hook failed: %v\", n.Config().ShortName, err)\n689: \t\t\t}\n690: \t\t}()\n691: \t}\n692: \n693: \twg.Wait()\n694: }\n695: \n696: func (c *CLab) deleteNodes(ctx context.Context, workers uint) {\n697: \twg := new(sync.WaitGroup)\n698: \n699: \tconcurrentChan := make(chan clabnodes.Node)\n700: \n701: \tworkerFunc := func(i uint, input chan clabnodes.Node, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {\n702: \t\tdefer wg.Done()\n703: \n704: \t\tfor {\n705: \t\t\tselect {\n706: \t\t\tcase n := <-input:\n707: \t\t\t\tif n == nil {\n708: \t\t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"Worker %d terminating...\", i)\n709: \t\t\t\t\treturn\n710: \t\t\t\t}\n711: \n712: \t\t\t\terr := n.Delete(ctx)\n713: \t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n714: \t\t\t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"could not remove container %q: %v\", n.Config().LongName, err)\n715: \t\t\t\t}\n716: \t\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n717: \t\t\t\treturn\n718: \t\t\t}\n719: \t\t}\n720: \t}\n721: \n722: \t// start concurrent workers\n723: \twg.Add(int(workers))\n724: \n725: \tfor i := range workers {\n726: \t\tgo workerFunc(i, concurrentChan, wg)\n727: \t}\n728: \n729: \t// send nodes to workers\n730: \tfor _, n := range c.Nodes {\n731: \t\tconcurrentChan <- n\n732: \t}\n733: \n734: \t// close channel to terminate the workers\n735: \tclose(concurrentChan)\n736: \n737: \twg.Wait()\n738: \n739: \t// Host and mgmt-br links must be removed only after node workers finish.\n740: \t// vxlan-stitch teardown deletes veth pairs from containers concurrently with\n741: \t// host-namespace VXLAN interfaces; running both at once races netlink deletes.\n742: \tc.deleteSpecialLinkNodes(ctx)\n743: }\n744: \n745: func (c *CLab) deleteSpecialLinkNodes(ctx context.Context) {\n746: \tspecialNodes := append(\n747: \t\t[]clablinks.Node{clablinks.GetHostLinkNode()},\n748: \t\tclablinks.GetMgmtBrLinkNodes()...,\n749: \t)\n750: \tfor _, n := range specialNodes {\n751: \t\terr := n.Delete(ctx)\n752: \t\tif err != nil {\n753: \t\t\tlog.Warn(err)\n754: \t\t}\n755: \t}\n756: }\n757: \n758: // deleteContainersDirect deletes containers directly via the runtime API.\n759: // This is used when we don't have node objects (e.g., destroy-by-name-only case).\n760: func (c *CLab) deleteContainersDirect(\n761: \tctx context.Context,\n762: \tcontainers []clabruntime.GenericContainer,\n763: ) {\n764: \tfor _, cont := range containers {\n765: \t\tif len(cont.Names) == 0 {\n766: \t\t\tlog.Warnf(\"skipping container %s with no names\", cont.ID)\n767: \t\t\tcontinue\n768: \t\t}\n769: \t\tname := cont.Names[0]\n770: \t\tlog.Infof(\"Removing container: %s\", name)\n771: \n772: \t\tc.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, cont)\n773: \t\trt := cont.Runtime\n774: \t\tif rt == nil {\n775: \t\t\trt = c.globalRuntime()\n776: \t\t}\n777: \t\terr := rt.DeleteContainer(ctx, name)\n778: \t\tif err != nil {\n779: \t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"could not remove container %q: %v\", name, err)\n780: \t\t}\n781: \t}\n782: }\n783: \n784: // deleteLeftoverLabContainers removes containers labeled for this lab whose\n785: // node is not part of the rendered topology. Deployments made with different\n786: // template variables, or nodes removed from the topology since, leave such\n787: // containers behind: topology-based destroy only deletes nodes of the rendered\n788: // node set, so these leftovers would survive every destroy otherwise.\n789: //\n790: // The sweep is skipped for node-filtered destroys (the filter deliberately\n791: // keeps non-selected nodes; nothing outside the filtered set may be removed)\n792: // and for tool containers (they are the deleteToolContainers flow's own\n793: // responsibility).\n794: func (c *CLab) deleteLeftoverLabContainers(ctx context.Context) {\n795: \tif len(c.nodeFilter) > 0 {\n796: \t\tlog.Debug(\"Skipping lab leftover sweeps: destroy is node-filtered; Reasoning
Key observations from destroy.go:

1. `deleteLeftoverLabContainers` — matches containers by lab label and removes those whose name isn't a rendered node LongName. The rendered set uses `node.Config().LongName`. For ext_container nodes, LongName = ShortName (external container name). ext_container nodes are in c.Nodes, so `ownedByTopology[ShortName]` protects external containers referenced by the topology. But wait: are external containers labeled with lab name? They're not created by clab, so they don't have clab labels → won't appear in `ListContainers(WithListLabName)`. So no issue.

But what about tailscale tool containers? They carry ToolType label → skipped. Good. What about `NodeKind` label? Tailscale sidecars have ToolType=tailscale, skipped.

Concern: `makeCopyForDestroy` uses `opts.varsFiles` or default `c.TopoPaths.VarsFilenamesAbsPath()`. If the deployment used different vars than what's available at destroy time (vars file deleted), the rendered node set differs → the sweep deletes those containers. That's the intent (remove leftovers). But the inverse risk: destroy with a topology file that has been edited to REMOVE nodes (user removed node from topo, hasn't run apply). Previous behavior: containers survived (bug being fixed). Now destroyed. That's intended behavior per the doc comment. Documented in docs? But the topology can override `prefix` (e.g. `prefix: __lab-name` or a custom prefix like "mylab"). The destroy parking sweep derives state-node long names as `fmt.Sprintf("clab-%s-%s", c.Config.Name, nodeName)` — this hardcodes the "clab" prefix. If the topology uses `prefix: __lab-name` or a custom prefix, state-recorded nodes' actual LongNames differ (e.g. `<lab>-<node>` or `<prefix>-<lab>-<node>`), so `SweepParkingNetnses` would not match their parking netns entries and parked interfaces would be left behind after destroy.

95: func ParkingNetnsName(containerName string) string {
96: 	name := parkingNetnsPrefix + containerName
97: 	if len(name) <= maxParkingNetnsNameLen {
98: 		return name

100:

106: 	if maxBaseLen < 1 {
107: 		return suffix

109:

111: }

115: // entries abandoned by an interrupted bridge-port migration or by a node that
116: // was parked outside of the lab's topology are swept, their parked ports
117: // included. Long names of nodes that never parked are skipped silently.
118: func SweepParkingNetnses(longNames ...string) error {
119: 	var errs []error
120: 	for _, longName := range longNames {
121: 		if longName == "" {
122: 			continue
123: 		}
124: 
125: 		name := ParkingNetnsName(longName)
126: 		if _, err := GetNamedNetNS(name); err != nil {
127: 			continue
128: 		}
129: 
130: 		if err := netns.DeleteNamed(name); err != nil {
131: 			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf(
132: 				"failed to remove parking netns %q: %w", name, err,
133: 			))
134: 		}
135: 	}
136: 	return errors.Join(errs...)
137: }
138: 
139: // LinkIPs returns IPv4/IPv6 addresses assigned to a link referred by its name.
140: func LinkIPs(ln string) (v4addrs, v6addrs []netlink.Addr, err error) {
141: 	l, err := netlink.LinkByName(ln)
142: 	if err != nil {
143: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to lookup link %q: %w", ln, err)
144: 	}
145: 
146: 	v4addrs, err = netlink.AddrList(l, netlink.FAMILY_V4)
147: 	if err != nil {
148: 		return nil, nil, err
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	v6addrs, err = netlink.AddrList(l, netlink.FAMILY_V6)
152: 	if err != nil {
153: 		return nil, nil, err
154: 	}
155: 
156: 	return
157: }
158: 
159: // FirstLinkIPs returns string representation of the first IPv4/v6 address
160: // found for a link referenced by name.
161: func FirstLinkIPs(ln string) (v4, v6 string, err error) {
162: 	v4addrs, v6addrs, err := LinkIPs(ln)
163: 	if err != nil {
164: 		return
165: 	}
166: 
167: 	if len(v4addrs) != 0 {
168: 		v4 = v4addrs[0].IP.String()
169: 	}
170: 
171: 	if len(v6addrs) != 0 {
172: 		v6 = v6addrs[0].IP.String()
173: 	}
174: 
175: 	return v4, v6, err
176: }
177: 
178: // GetLinksByNamePrefix returns a list of links whose name matches a prefix.
179: func GetLinksByNamePrefix(prefix string) ([]netlink.Link, error) {
180: 	// filtered list of interfaces
181: 	if prefix == "" {
182: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("prefix is not specified")
183: 	}
184: 	var fls []netlink.Link
185: 
186: 	ls, err := netlink.LinkList()
187: 	if err != nil {
188: 		return nil, err
189: 	}
190: 	for _, l := range ls {
191: 		if strings.HasPrefix(l.Attrs().Name, prefix) {
192: 			fls = append(fls, l)
193: 		}
194: 	}
195: 	if len(fls) == 0 {
196: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no links found by specified prefix %s", prefix)
197: 	}
198: 	return fls, nil
199: }

201: func GetRouteForIP(ip net.IP) (*rtnl.Route, error) {
202: 	conn, err := rtnl.Dial(nil)
203: 	if err != nil {
204: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("can't establish netlink connection: %s", err)
205: 	}
206: 	defer conn.Close()
207: 
208: 	r, err := conn.RouteGet(ip)
209: 
210: 	return r, err
211: }

213: func CreateNamedNetNS(name string) (string, error) {
214: 	nsPath := filepath.Join("/run/netns", name)
215: 
216: 	goruntime.LockOSThread()
217: 	defer goruntime.UnlockOSThread()
218: 
219: 	currentNS, err := netns.Get()
220: 	if err != nil {
221: 		return "", err
222: 	}
223: 	defer currentNS.Close()
224: 
225: 	defer func() {
226: 		_ = netns.Set(currentNS)
227: 	}()
228: 
229: 	newNS, err := netns.NewNamed(name)
230: 	if err != nil {
231: 		if os.IsExist(err) && FileOrDirExists(nsPath) {
232: 			return nsPath, nil
233: 		}
234: 		return "", err
235: 	}
236: 
237: 	newNS.Close()
238: 
239: 	return nsPath, nil
240: }

242: // create a new netns or return the nspath if it exists.
243: func CreateOrGetNamedNetNS(name string) (string, error) {
244: 	if nsPath, err := GetNamedNetNS(name); err == nil {
245: 		return nsPath, nil
246: 	}
247: 
248: 	return CreateNamedNetNS(name)
249: }

252: func GetNamedNetNS(name string) (string, error) {
253: 	nsPath := filepath.Join("/run/netns", name)
254: 	if !FileOrDirExists(nsPath) {
255: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("named netns %q does not exist", name)
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	return nsPath, nil
259: }

Now, the destroy parking sweep uses `fmt.Sprintf("clab-%s-%s", c.Config.Name, nodeName)` for state nodes. But `nodeLongName` depends on `c.Config.Prefix`. Default prefix is "clab" (set where? defaults in clab.go — `Prefix: &__prefix` where default "clab"). If a topology sets `prefix: __lab-name` or custom prefix, then during deploy the state records nodes; on destroy the parking netns entries were created with the actual LongName (e.g. `mylab-node1` or `myprefix-lab-node1`), and the sweep's derived `clab-<lab>-<node>` won't match → parked ports are never swept and leftover named netns `clab-park-...` remain.

But wait — the copy for destroy parses the same topology, so `c.Config.Prefix` is available in destroy too. The sweep could use `c.nodeLongName(nodeName)` instead of hardcoding "clab-". That's the concrete correction. However — how impactful? Parking netns entries are created by bridge migration paths (parkMigratedBridgeNSPorts) and lifecycle parking (existing feature? park during node recreate). Also `c.Nodes` long names use `cfg.LongName` which respects prefix. Only state-derived ones hardcode. So finding: destroy.go line 507 hardcodes `clab-` prefix; topologies with non-default `prefix` leave parking netns entries (and parked interfaces!) behind. Parked interfaces inside those netns would linger on the host — a resource leak. But also `deleteLeftoverLabContainers` compares `cont.Names[0]` with LongName — containers named by LongName; that comparison uses rendered LongName so fine.
